title: SoterAI IDE Guard
description: Settings for the SoterAI IDE Guard JupyterLab adapter (PLANNED / UNBUILT).

useServerProxy.title: Route broker calls through the same-host server extension
useServerProxy.description: Recommended. When true, broker calls go through a Jupyter server extension that holds the broker token server-side, so the token never enters the browser. Required for remote/hosted Jupyter. When false, the browser talks to http://127.0.0.1 directly (desktop, same machine only).

brokerPort.title: Local broker port
brokerPort.description: Loopback port used only when 'useServerProxy' is false.

outputMonitor.title: Enable output-leak monitor
outputMonitor.description: When enabled, new code-cell output text is scanned by the broker and only redacted findings are shown. Off by default.
